reviews.title: Helped me get my money back
reviews.text: I downloaded this to try and get some money back from services I'd used before, and so far it has worked well. The app has a very easy to use selection screen that lets you pick the brands you have used before. Overall a great, easy to use app that is worth the small investment.

reviews.title: Super easy to use
reviews.text: I got a postcard for a class action settlement and almost ignored it because filing it seemed like a hassle. After finding this app, I answered a few questions and now have a claim worth over $500. I also discovered other opportunities I never knew existed. Glad I gave it a try.

reviews.title: Review update
reviews.text: My phone was taken and someone purchased this app, and I was charged for a random subscription.  They did refund me under the circumstances (since Apple would not).  I could not and did not benefit from this app.  I appreciate the service and can safely say I was not scammed considering they refunded me.

reviews.title: Amazing! Clean Simple and Easy to Use
reviews.text: This app definitely has exceeded my expectations. Everything is smooth and easy for figure out. I can’t wait to see what money I can find!

reviews.title: App feels misleading
reviews.text: So when you install it it crows about the thousand of dollars you may receive, before asking for a $40 payment with no trial period. Why do I have a feeling that if I paid it I suddenly wouldn’t have any available claim opportunities? If this is legit why not let me try it first? Maybe like one claim to evaluate the platform.

reviews.title: Made me so much money
reviews.text: This app is a NO BRAINER. You pay a little to get so much cash back. Recommending to everyone I know

reviews.title: What’s the catch?
reviews.text: So far the app is great! I’m giving it 5 stars because I’m waiting for the catch. How much is it going to cost me to actually use the app to get money?
